note: Display layers for the Bridge. Each block names its source file; absent layers are listed in 'missing'.

waves.encoding: uint8[leads][ny][nx], decimetres rounded up, 255 = no value (land, or under sea ice where the wave model writes NaN)
waves.reduction: 3x3 block max of VHM0_dmax (the daily max of 3-hourly significant wave height) onto the 0.25 deg ice grid
waves.day_max_note: full-resolution daily max over the box; the source gate uses it as the worst case for open-water cells with no wave value
waves.source: E.U. Copernicus Marine Service Information (CMEMS); GLOBAL_ANALYSIS_FORECAST_WAV_001_027

wind.encoding: int8 U[leads][ny][nx] then int8 V[leads][ny][nx], units of 0.25 m/s (eastward, northward 10 m wind)
wind.reduction: every 2nd point of the native 0.25 deg IFS grid; one step per forecast day, nearest to 12 UTC (dakshin/real_world.py rule)
wind.licence: Contains modified ECMWF open data (CC BY 4.0), https://www.ecmwf.int/en/forecasts/datasets/open-data

depth.encoding: int16 little-endian [ny][nx]: elevation in metres of the SHALLOWEST point in each 0.10 deg block (negative = below sea level); 32767 = mostly land or ice surface
depth.reduction: 2x2 block max of 'elevation' (itself the shallowest value per 0.05 deg cell)
depth.source: Corridor bathymetry, Cape Town-Bharati, 0.05 deg (IBCSO v2 south of 50S, GEBCO_2020 north of 50S)
depth.citation: South of 50S: Dorschel, B., Hehemann, L., Viquerat, S., et al. (2022). The International Bathymetric Chart of the Southern Ocean Version 2. Scientific Data 9, 275, https://doi.org/10.1038/s41597-022-01366-7; dataset PANGAEA, https://doi.org/10.1594/PANGAEA.937574 (CC-BY-4.0). North of 50S: GEBCO Compilation Group (2020) GEBCO 2020 Grid, https://doi.org/10.5285/a29c5465-b138-234d-e053-6c86abc040b9 (public domain).
depth.licence: IBCSO v2 part: CC-BY-4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/); GEBCO_2020 part: public domain, attribution requested
depth.caveat: IBCSO and GEBCO are scientific compilations, not official electronic navigational charts (ENC). Not for navigation.

bergs.source: US National Ice Center Antarctic iceberg list (AntarcticIcebergs_20261120.csv)
bergs.uncertainty_provenance: dakshin/figures/berg_hindcast.json: uncertainty_radius_km_per_day (median drift-model error over the USNIC hindcast)
bergs.uncertainty_rule: radius_km = uncertainty_km_per_day x days between the position fix and the time shown; no circle for times before the fix

berg_tracks.model: WDE17 drift on GLO12 forecast currents, RK2 1 h, zero wind (stated limitation, see berg_hindcast.json), grounding-aware (assumed 207 m keel vs IBCSO)
berg_tracks.validation: see berg_hindcast.json — persistence beats this model on the 2026 sample; arrows are advisory, the circles grow at the measured 4.35 km/day error rate

research.note: Research layers: full-resolution fields for the latest clean cycle, bathymetry, and satellite-vs-model verification. Older cycles are shown at 0.25 deg from data/cycles.

sic.licence: Copernicus Marine Service licence (free with registration; credit required): E.U. Copernicus Marine Service Information

thk.licence: Copernicus Marine Service licence (free with registration; credit required): E.U. Copernicus Marine Service Information

idrift.licence: Copernicus Marine Service licence (free with registration; credit required): E.U. Copernicus Marine Service Information
idrift.variable: usi, vsi (u block then v block)

cur.variable: uo, vo at 0.494 m (u block then v block), daily mean
cur.licence: Copernicus Marine Service licence (free with registration; credit required): E.U. Copernicus Marine Service Information

sst.freezing_point_note: approximate freezing point of seawater at salinity ~34-35 (legend mark only)
sst.licence: Copernicus Marine Service licence (free with registration; credit required): E.U. Copernicus Marine Service Information

wav.variable: VHM0_dmax (daily max of 3-hourly Hs) block, then VMDR_at_dmax (mean direction waves come FROM at that time)
wav.licence: Copernicus Marine Service licence (free with registration; credit required): E.U. Copernicus Marine Service Information

wind.variable: u10, v10 (u block then v block), native 0.25 deg
wind.licence: Contains modified ECMWF open data (CC BY 4.0), https://www.ecmwf.int/en/forecasts/datasets/open-data

bathy.source: Corridor bathymetry, Cape Town-Bharati, 0.05 deg (IBCSO v2 south of 50S, GEBCO_2020 north of 50S)
bathy.citation: South of 50S: Dorschel, B., Hehemann, L., Viquerat, S., et al. (2022). The International Bathymetric Chart of the Southern Ocean Version 2. Scientific Data 9, 275, https://doi.org/10.1038/s41597-022-01366-7; dataset PANGAEA, https://doi.org/10.1594/PANGAEA.937574 (CC-BY-4.0). North of 50S: GEBCO Compilation Group (2020) GEBCO 2020 Grid, https://doi.org/10.5285/a29c5465-b138-234d-e053-6c86abc040b9 (public domain).
bathy.licence: IBCSO v2 part: CC-BY-4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/); GEBCO_2020 part: public domain, attribution requested
bathy.caveat: IBCSO and GEBCO are scientific compilations, not official electronic navigational charts (ENC). Not for navigation.

truth.layout: uint8 conc[D][ny][nx] (%, 255 nodata) then uint8 qa[D][ny][nx]
truth.suspect_rule: qa & (4 | 8): land spillover filter or no input (dakshin/ice_quality.py)
truth.source: NOAA/NSIDC G10016 v4 NRT CDR (AMSR2), 25 km EPSG:3412
truth.citation: Meier, W. N. et al. NOAA/NSIDC Near-Real-Time CDR of Passive Microwave Sea Ice Concentration, Version 4 (G10016). NSIDC. DOI 10.7265/tgam-yv28

model.rule: CMEMS 1/12 deg siconc area-averaged (cos-lat weights) into each 25 km truth cell; a cell needs at least half of its area modelled

verif.innovation: model minus satellite, percentage points; suspect satellite cells are not scored (hatched)

analysis_currents.variable: uo, vo at 0.494 m (u block then v block), daily mean ANALYSIS for each valid day
analysis_currents.label: analysis (reanalysis-style), not the forecast
analysis_currents.source: CMEMS GLOBAL_ANALYSISFORECAST_PHY_001_024 currents, daily analysis, 1/12 deg
analysis_currents.licence: Copernicus Marine Service licence (free with registration; credit required): E.U. Copernicus Marine Service Information

ai.grid: 25 km NSIDC (model-native); the correction does not add resolution
